blocks.title: Seismometer
blocks.text: Seismometer aisa aala hai jo zameen ke neeche chattanon ki kisi bhi harkat, ya zalzalon, aatish-fishan (volcano) phatne aur dhamakon se paida larzish ka jawab deta hai. Yeh electromagnetic induction se zameen ki harkat ko electrical signals mein badal kar zalzale pakarta hai.

Aam taur par seismometer mein spring se latka ek wazan hota hai. Jab zalzala aata hai to zameen hilti hai magar wazan apne jumood (inertia) ki wajah se saakin rehne ki koshish karta hai. Is se wazan aur seismometer ke frame, jo zameen se jura hai, ke darmiyan nisbati harkat hoti hai. Wazan aksar aise magnet se jura hota hai jo taar ki coil ke andar chalta hai (Fig. 10.19). Yeh intezam Faraday ke electromagnetic induction ke qanoon par kaam karta hai: coil se badalta magnetic flux coil mein emf induce karta hai, jo induced electric current paida karti hai.

blocks.alt: Zameen par khare frame mein spring par latakta magnet aik coil ke andar hai jo frame se juri hai. Zameen hile to coil us ke saath hilti hai jabke magnet peechhe reh jata hai, is liye coil se flux badalta hai aur emf paida hota hai; taar use recorder tak le jate hain jo lakeer banata hai.
blocks.caption: Seismometer: spring par laga magnet zameen ki harkat record karta hai (Figure 10.19 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Induced current zameen ki harkat ki velocity ke tanasub mein hai. Bane hue electrical signals barhaye (amplify) aur record kiye jate hain, jo zalzale ki waves ke amplitude, frequency aur muddat ki maloomat dete hain. Data ka tajziya kar ke zalzale ki mukhtalif khusoosiyat, jaise jagah, shiddat (magnitude) aur gehrai, maloom ki jati hain.

Aam taur par seismometer zameen ke neeche 50 se 1000 metre ki gehrai par ek hifazati dabbe mein dafan kiya jata hai jise vault kehte hain: taqreeban 1 metre chaura aur 2 metre gehra nalkidar steel tank jis ke pende par concrete ka chabutra hota hai (Fig. 10.20). Fig. 10.20 ke station mein suraj ki energy batteries charge karti hai, GPS jagah batata hai, vault ka seismic saaman data bhejta hai, aur computer data mehfooz karta hai.

Zyada tar zalzale plate tectonics (displacement) se aate hain. Kitab taqreeban 60 km gehrai tak wale zalzalon ko shallow, 280 km tak wale ko intermediate, aur 280 km se zyada gehrai wale ko deep kehti hai (For Your Information). Seismic waves ki do bari aqsam hain: P-waves, yaani primary waves, jo longitudinal hain, aur S-waves, yaani secondary waves, jo fitrat mein transverse hain (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: Spring se latka magnet galvanometer se jure coil ke andar bahar jhoolta hai. Galvanometer kya dikhata hai (MCQ 10.10)? Hassas aale ko bhatakti magnetic fields se bachane ke liye aap kya karenge (constructed response 10.9)?
blocks.explanation: Magnet ke andar aane par coil se flux barhta aur bahar jane par ghatta hai, to galvanometer baen aur daen jhoolta hai; Lenz ke qanoon se induced currents harkat ki mukhalifat karte aur us se energy lete hain, to jhoolna aur jhukao dheere dheere khatam hote hain: option (d). Aale ko naram lohe (soft iron) ya kisi aur zyada permeability wale maadde ke dabbe mein band karein, jo bairooni field lines ko andar ke gird se guzar deta hai ta ke dabbe ke andar field bohat kam ho.

items: Seismometer: frame par coil ke andar spring par magnet; zameen aur coil hilte hain, magnet jumood se saakin rehta hai, badalta flux emf induce karta hai (Faraday ka qanoon); induced current zameen ki velocity ke tanasub mein; barha kar record karne se jagah, shiddat aur gehrai.
50 se 1000 m neeche vault (taqreeban 1 m by 2 m steel tank) mein dafan; P-waves longitudinal, S-waves transverse; zyada tar zalzale plate tectonics se.
